title: Origin story: Duskmantle
description: Duskmantle was a seamstress who sewed cloaks for spies and lovers, and learned to sew dusk itself into the lining. Her mantles hide the wearer in plain sight — not invisible, just unnoticed, the way evening settles. She asks no questions of her clients, and her discretion is absolute.

title: Ability profile: Duskmantle
description: Ranked abilities: Seamcraft — rank 100/100; Discretion — rank 100/100; Dusk-weaving — rank 98/100; Kindness — rank 96/100; Perception — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Duskmantle
description: Powers: Her mantles grant unnoticeability; Dusk itself is her material; She is forgotten the moment she leaves — by design.

title: Stamina feats: Duskmantle
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Sewed through a siege; Kept every client's secret.

title: Crossover notes: Duskmantle
description: Duskmantle crosses naturally with: dusk, concealment, the gentle hidden.

title: Design notes: Duskmantle
description: Concealment as mercy; the seamstress of evening.

title: Generator record: Duskmantle
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Duskmantle's database.
